appDescription: Узнайте, кто не подписан на вас, и ведите историю подписок.
statusIdle: Open your Instagram profile, then press Sync. Leave that tab in front.
statusPaused: Paused during $1$. $2$ saved. Come back to the Instagram tab and press Resume.
statusBlocked: Instagram asked you to try again later. What was collected is saved.
statusStalled: Instagram stopped sending $1$. $2$ saved. Press Resume later.
emptyNotFollowingReady: Everyone you follow follows you back.
lastSyncedShortList: $1$. A list was short of the profile count.
syncStarting: Starting the sync. Leave the Instagram tab in front.
syncRefreshTab: Refresh the Instagram tab, then press Sync again.
syncAlreadyRunning: A sync is already running in this tab.
errOpenProfile: Open your Instagram profile, then press Sync.
errProfileTimeout: Instagram did not open your profile.
errCloseDialog: Could not close the open list. Close it, then press Sync again.
errCountNotFound: Could not find the $1$ count on your profile.
errListNotOpen: Instagram did not open the list. Refresh the page and try again.
